description: Unit test source file for minidump file writer in the breakpad project, testing writing and comparing minidump files.

methods.name: WriteFile
methods.description: Creates a minidump file with test structures and data, then closes the writer.

methods.name: CompareFile
methods.description: Reads the generated minidump file and compares its contents to expected byte sequence.

methods.name: RunTests
methods.description: Runs the write and compare tests, then deletes the test file.
